verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs say any signal can be evaluated for abnormal behavior instead of against a threshold, so the product itself offers anomaly-style alerting. The evidence is a single overview sentence that gives no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of the anomaly or outlier detection mechanism (baselines, sensitivity, seasonality), outlier detection across entities, how it is enabled and configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.
